card.name: Verbs of telling your doctor
card.fires_on: The verb or 'to' that comes right before 'your/their doctor' or 'healthcare provider', in advice to patients to contact, notify, call, report to or ask a clinician.

card.writes: It promotes 'your' and similar possessives, so the next word is likely 'your' or 'their' before doctor or provider.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before 'your doctor' in advice to tell a doctor about symptoms.
